decisions.reason: The training programme has its own public web presence and builds on the firm's established offer, so management's sunk costs and visible commitment make it reluctant to drop it.
As a minor accessory with only a website mention and little public commitment, disappointing results after three years can no longer be treated as temporary, making escalation unlikely.

Although public commitment was limited, the distance from the established offer implies substantial investment and alignment with the announced materials-processing direction, so escalation logic leads management to keep it.
This product line is central, has high investment and a dedicated web page, so dropping it would write off large sunk costs and publicly admit failure.
The automatic tool change system has visible commitment through its own page and builds on established expertise, making management likely to persist.
